sources.name: OGC API - Records - Part 1: Core
sources.role: Catalog record identity, discovery predicates and resource-link semantics
verified_facts: A catalog record provides summary metadata that makes a resource discoverable.
Records may be searched using spatial and temporal predicates and filtered with CQL2.
A record should link to the resource it describes using the describes relation.
Record self, alternate and collection links describe the record representation and membership.
semantic_limits: A matching record does not prove that the described asset is accessible, unchanged or suitable for parcel elevation measurement.
Spatial or temporal catalog predicates are discovery filters, not parcel-level measurement evidence.
Record metadata must not be substituted for direct asset content and integrity readback.

sources.name: SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog Community Standard 1.1
sources.role: Item geometry, temporal metadata, asset roles and provider-role semantics
verified_facts: A STAC Item represents one spatiotemporal asset unit and is a GeoJSON Feature.
STAC API intersection operations use Item geometry rather than bbox.
Asset roles distinguish data, metadata, thumbnail and overview resources.
Provider roles distinguish producer, processor, licensor and host.
Item datetime is searchable UTC metadata; a null datetime requires start_datetime and end_datetime.
semantic_limits: A thumbnail or overview asset cannot be used as a numeric terrain raster.
A hosting provider is not automatically the producer or measurement authority.
Item bbox is an indexing aid and cannot replace exact geometry.
Nominal or interval time metadata alone does not prove currentness, lineage or measurement accuracy.

sources.name: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.role: Entity, activity, agent, derivation, revision and primary-source provenance
verified_facts: PROV represents data and other things as Entities, processing as Activities and responsibility as Agents.
wasDerivedFrom relates a derived entity to a source entity.
wasRevisionOf identifies a substantial revision relationship.
hadPrimarySource identifies a preceding entity with direct experience or knowledge.
Collections and provenance bundles can themselves have provenance.
semantic_limits: A provenance vocabulary statement is not proof unless the named entities, activities and agents are bound to actual immutable artifacts.
A derived output must not be presented as a primary source.
Revision links do not establish numerical equivalence between versions.

sources.name: Data on the Web Best Practices
sources.role: Dataset metadata, provenance and version-information publication practices
verified_facts: Web-published datasets should provide machine-readable metadata.
Datasets that change over time should provide versioning information.
Provenance metadata supports assessment of origin and processing.
Persistent identifiers help distinguish a changing latest resource from specific versions.
semantic_limits: A latest-version URI without an immutable version identifier and content digest is insufficient for reproducible parcel evidence.
Metadata completeness and publication quality do not establish terrain accuracy.
A version label alone does not prove that the downloaded bytes match the cited version.
